title: AI.md agent entry point
description: Front matter of `.ai/AI.md`, the one document every agent must read first. Rule 1 of CONTEXT_SPEC 2 makes this the single document whose front-matter block is optional, so nothing here is required: an `AI.md` with no block at all is valid, and this schema exists to constrain a block that was written rather than to insist on one. `AI.md` carries no `id` because it is a fixed path with a single instance, and giving it one would imply a second copy could exist.

title.description: Human-readable name of the entry point. Absent in the shipped template, because the level-1 heading already says it.

version.description: Semantic version of the contract this file describes.

iso-date.description: ISO-8601 calendar date. The pattern asserts the shape; whether 2026-13-01 is a real day is decided by the code, not by an annotation.

tags.description: Free labels for retrieval. An empty list and an absent key are different facts and both are preserved.
